name: Tithi
desc: Lunar day — the angle between Sun and Moon. 30 Tithis per lunar month divided into Shukla (waxing) and Krishna (waning) Pakshas. Determines auspiciousness of activities.

name: Vara
desc: Weekday — Sunday (Sun) through Saturday (Saturn). Each day is ruled by a specific Graha, influencing the nature of actions performed.

name: Nakshatra
desc: The Moon's position among the 27 lunar mansions. The Nakshatra of the Moon at birth determines the starting Dasha period and core mental nature.

name: Yoga
desc: Luni-solar angle — 27 Yogas based on the combined longitudes of Sun and Moon. Each Yoga has its own quality, from auspicious (Ayushman) to challenging (Vyatipata).

name: Karana
desc: Half-Tithi — 11 types of Karanas. Bava, Balava, Kaulava repeat in sequence. Vishti (Bhadra) is considered inauspicious for most activities.
